what: Hovering a two-color gradient (119°) button turns on a layer of the same gradient flipped 180° (−61°) over 0.3s ease-out, and a shadow settles in — the colors stay the same but the light direction turns, so the button looks pressable. The quick menu, login and consultation buttons in the bank side panel are all this.

options.--fx-from-at · --fx-to-at: Two color positions, default -50% · 150% (original login button). The consult button uses 0% · 100%
options.--fx-angle: Default 119deg — the flipped layer uses this value −180°
options.look: If flat, light direction only with no shadow

use: Log in

from.where: shared.css .ib-btn · .ib-quick a · .ib-bnr__btn (bottom strip banner) — original .modBtnRoundGreen:after·.globalNavButtons a:before
